pictures.scene: a vast night sky opening high above a dark still horizon, with a great column of pale light coming down through it from far beyond the highest clouds
an immense host of small burning lights ranged in ordered ranks across the whole of a dark sky, rank behind rank into the far distance, like an army drawn up out of stars

exactly two round lights in the whole picture and nothing else lit anywhere in it: a golden sun high on the left and a pale full moon high on the right, hung at the same height as each other, with the thick band of the milky way and countless stars burning between them, and the land beneath them one flat unlit silhouette of low hills running from edge to edge under a horizon of plain dark sky
a still ocean of water hanging above the clouds, its calm surface lit from beneath, with the ordinary sky far below it
the first light breaking over a dark formless deep, one clean edge of gold dividing the water from the sky
an immense mountain of bare grey stone standing unmoved under a sky of slow-turning stars
the deep open sea seen from within it, with shafts of green light falling far down into the dark and the huge dim shape of a whale passing through them
a great storm over open country, a single fork of lightning going down through black cloud, with snow and hail driving across the wind
a range of high hills covered in ancient cedars, the great dark trees standing along the ridges
a wide grassland at first light with a great flock of birds rising from it into the open sky
a plain golden crown and a shepherd's wooden staff laid together on a worn stone step before the open gate of an ancient city at dawn
the round earth seen small and far below an immense burning glory of light that fills the whole sky above it
a ram's horn trumpet resting on a great stone altar in the first light of morning, with a single shaft of dawn falling across it

lines.text: Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD from the heavens;
praise Him in the highest places.
Praise Him, all His angels;
praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
Praise Him, O sun and moon;
praise Him, all you shining stars.
Praise Him, O highest heavens,
and you waters above the skies.
Let them praise the name of the LORD,
for He gave the command and they were created.
He established them forever and ever;
He issued a decree that will never pass away.
Praise the LORD from the earth,
all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
lightning and hail, snow and clouds,
powerful wind fulfilling His word,
mountains and all hills,
fruit trees and all cedars,
wild animals and all cattle,
crawling creatures and flying birds,
kings of the earth and all peoples,
princes and all rulers of the earth,
young men and maidens,
old and young together.
Let them praise the name of the LORD,
for His name alone is exalted;
His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
He has raised up a horn for His people,
the praise of all His saints,
of Israel, a people near to Him.
Hallelujah!
